annotations.title: Add a website and build its SEO plan

description: Adds a website to the user's AI SEO Crew account and starts building its SEO plan: the crew reads the site, works out what the business sells and plans articles from real Google searches. Use it when someone wants SEO done for their website, wants blog posts that bring traffic from Google, or wants to start a blog on WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Framer or a coded site. Free, takes about three minutes. Then call get_seo_plan with the returned site_id.
name: add_site
